desc: Room of ore — a 7x5 (35-block) 1-high iron-ore slab the mine mission drains end to end. Mission-mode A/B: run mine under each planner (astar, dstar), measure ticks from mission_start to SCAN_EXHAUSTED (full drain). 1-high so every block is reachable from an adjacent floor cell (a 2-high body's top layer needs a climb/dig-up the plain mine loop blocks on). Measures whole-mission throughput — nav-between-ore + break — per planner.
